verdict.rationale: TrueLayer provides building blocks for unattended payment flows. Once a user authorises a mandate, payments on it execute immediately without further authorisation, which supports recurring payments. Console lets you configure sweeping, and webhooks deliver event notifications that an integration can react to. However, there is no evidence of a first-party automation or scheduling feature: the developer must build and host the background logic. Missing for 10: native scheduled or triggered automation workflows, agent-driven background execution (the MCP server is only shown for interactive Claude use), and documentation or hands-on corroboration of autonomous automation setup.
